title: Workflows

empty.title: No workflows yet
empty.description: A workflow recognizes a type of document and applies actions to it: rename, move, convert…

createSoon: Creating workflows comes in the next version.
orderHelp: Workflows are tried from top to bottom: the first one that recognizes a document applies.
list: Workflows, in the order they are tried
dragHandle: Move “{{name}}” (drag, or Space then arrow keys)
deleteDescription: The workflow will no longer apply to new documents. Files already processed do not change.
conflict: This workflow was changed in the meantime: the list was reloaded.
continues: The following workflows are tried too

drag.cancel: Move cancelled: “{{name}}” is back in place.
drag.instructions: Press Space to pick up a workflow, the arrow keys to move it, Space to drop it or Escape to cancel.
